name: @playform/ets-plugin-dsh-workspace-context
description: The workspace-context service: a DeepSeek Harness plugin that plays the workspace family's attention-projection role - the required/relevant/deferred context economy. The service (registered as ctx.workspaceContext) builds the ORIENTATION PACKET from the sibling workspace-graph index: the eight fixed sections WORKSPACE (the index revision), SCOPE (the query or focus), MAP (the top modules and their one-line roles), FOCUS (the node, its span, its fingerprint, its version), NEIGHBORS (the strongest edges, ranked by edge strength - a call beats a reference, a test beats a mention), EVIDENCE (the files/spans the packet is built from), OPEN (the questions the packet cannot answer - honest gaps, never guesses), and STALE (the version the caller held, when it differs). The packet is BOUNDED: the budget targets 2000 tokens (estimated chars/4, or the harness ctx.tokenMeter when available) with a configurable hard cap; the weakest neighbors are dropped first until the packet fits, and every clamp is ledgered. The LENSES (code, docs, tests - the default catalog) select which node and edge kinds participate. The model-facing surface is the workspace_context tool (read-only, one canonical JSON value). The plugin ships DISABLED - the IDLE-forever posture. Plan: Documentation/Plans/WORKSPACE-FAMILY-V4-1.md section 3.5 + Documentation/Plans/Workspace-Family/CONTEXT.md.
